messages:
neha (AE): Orchid Systems requested per-question SIG evidence for the crypto + access-control sections. They want both artifacts and a short reproducible extraction log.

kevin (SE): Happy to build that. Quick clarification: do they need the full audit trail (redacted) or just rotation events + ACLs?

tess (InfoSec): For SIG 3.x we should provide: KMS rotation records, who/role performed rotations, TLS termination point, and any HSM usage notes. If we provide audit logs, redact ARNs and any customer identifiers.

neha (AE): They explicitly asked for rotation proof and role mapping only. Keep the bundle small. Also asked if we can mark which artifacts are from Hosted vs Private deployments.

omar (Solutions): Plan: create a zip with folders `hosted/` and `private/` where applicable, include `rotation_manifest.csv`, `acl_snapshot.json` (redacted), `tls_snapshot.txt`, and `how_to_validate.md`. I'll add a README with citations to our docs.

kevin (SE): I'll run an export against staging and prepare sanitized logs. Sample command I'll run (sanitized):
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  "https://internal-api/export?questions=3.1,3.2&since=2024-02-01" \
  -o orchid-sig-crypto-2024-04.zip

tess (InfoSec): When you produce the zip: include `redaction_manifest.txt` listing fields redacted and why. Also include a short attestation paragraph signed by InfoSec (not legal).

neha (AE): Customer would like to see an example KMS rotation API call (redacted) and a sample of rotation metadata format. Could we include a sanitized `rotation_event.json`?

omar (Solutions): Yes, include `rotation_event_example.json` with fake_resource_id + timestamps. Also include `verify.sh` that runs `sha256sum` and validates the export.

kevin (SE): ETA: I'll run export tonight and drop artifact in the Jira ticket. I'll also paste the README excerpt here.

deploy-bot: Deployment staging-dedicated-3 finished: https://ci.redwood/release/7890

tess (InfoSec): Note: if we see any gaps (e.g., missing rotation metadata before 2023-09) we'll call it out in `exceptions.txt`. Better to be explicit.

kevin (SE): README excerpt:
"Included:
- hosted/rotation_manifest.csv (redacted)
- private/rotation_manifest.csv (redacted)
- tls_snapshot.txt
- acl_snapshot.json (roles only)
- rotation_event_example.json
- redaction_manifest.txt
- infosec_attestation.txt
To validate:
  sha256sum -c export_manifest.txt
See how_to_validate.md for steps to reproduce the extraction via API (no secrets)."

neha (AE): I'll propose Thu 11-12 PT for a walkthrough after they review. Also note: customer asked about whether backups of keys are exported; we should explicitly say no.

kevin (SE): Confirmed — backups are not part of this export. We'll state that in attestation and README.

kevin (SE): Uploaded orchid-sig-crypto-2024-04.zip (sanitized) to SIG-4950: https://redwood.internal/jira/browse/SIG-4950

tess (InfoSec): Draft attestation: "Redwood InfoSec attests that these artifacts represent observed rotation events and access-control snapshots as of export date 2024-04-05. Sensitive identifiers were redacted; backups and secret material are excluded. This is an operational attestation and not a legal certification."

neha (AE): Perfect, I'll relay to Orchid and lock in the walkthrough. Thanks team :rocket:
